title: Joe Burrow: This is the most talented roster since I've been in Cincinnati

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Burrow: This is the most talented roster since I've been in Cincinnati
sources.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow said earlier this week that the team has "everything we need" to contend for a Super Bowl title and he doubled down on his belief in the team's capabilities at a press conference on Wednesday.
